title: project_snapshot
description: Baseline snapshot of project state captured at end of Phase 2 by skill-architect. Used by drift detection to identify changes over time.

captured_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this snapshot was taken

captured_by_phase.description: Always written at end of Phase 2

source.description: Whether project data came from scanning an existing codebase or from Description Mode

file_counts.description: Count of files by extension at snapshot time. Keys must be extensions including the dot (e.g. '.php', '.js'). Keys without a leading dot are rejected.

total_file_count.description: Total number of files in the project at snapshot time

top_directories.description: Names of top-level directories present at snapshot time

domains.description: Detected domains copied from skill_requirements.json at Phase 1

skill_justifications.description: Per-skill two-layer justification record. Key is the skill name.

discovery_evidence.description: Tags from Phase 1 that caused this skill to be generated (e.g. 'database:MySQL', 'file_type:.sql')

discovery_justification.description: The plain-text justification string for generating this skill, copied from Phase 1's skill_requirements.json

human_confirmed_reason.description: Plain-language reason the user confirmed this skill is needed

confirmed_by_human.description: Whether the user explicitly confirmed this skill at Phase 2

confirmed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of human confirmation. Null if not yet confirmed.

prominence_score.description: Latest prominence score from Layer 1 detection. Null until first drift check runs.

prominence_verdict.description: Latest prominence verdict. Null until first drift check runs.

last_checked_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last drift check for this skill. Null if never checked.

mcp_justifications.description: Per-MCP two-layer justification record. Key is the MCP name.

discovery_evidence.description: Tags from Phase 1 that caused this MCP to be recommended

discovery_justification.description: The plain-text justification string for recommending this MCP, copied from Phase 1 recommendations

human_confirmed_reason.description: Plain-language reason the user confirmed this MCP is needed

last_drift_check.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last drift check run against this snapshot. Null if never checked.

accumulated_commit_weight.description: Running total of commit weights accumulated since this snapshot was written. Resets to 0 when snapshot is regenerated.

drift_check_count.description: How many drift checks have been run against this snapshot total

last_analyzed_commit.description: Git commit hash of HEAD when the snapshot was taken, used as a reference anchor for commit weight
